profile.input_contract: JSON pendulum initial state and integration horizon.
profile.output_contract: JSON scalar phase-space and Hamiltonian energy metrics.
profile.adapter: Pure-stdlib Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p4/.

mrs.description: Energy-invariant convergence: for the same Hamiltonian pendulum initial state and physical time interval, doubling the number of velocity-Verlet integration steps halves dt and must reduce the bounded energy-drift observable.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: refining the time step of a symplectic Hamiltonian integrator should reduce measured energy drift for the same trajectory interval.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField to /integration/n_steps with factor=2; t_final and initial q/p remain unchanged, so dt is halved.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `energy_drift` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `p4-energy-invariant`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `less` / `LessThan` checks that follow-up energy_drift is strictly less than source energy_drift.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal deterministic predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when the SUT exposes /integration/n_steps and outputs scalar `energy_drift` over a deterministic Hamiltonian pendulum run.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the solver, adapter, or transform binding did not preserve the expected energy-invariant refinement behavior.
